questions.question: What should come next for OP-01? The reopen for O65–O72 is the main path; a backlog item for the split-dialog problem (a restart sends an answer to the wrong session log, the next session asks again and gets a different answer) could come first, and so could a PR to merge the reviewed state.

options.label: Backlog item, then reopen (Recommended)
options.description: I file a BK item now: answers lost to a split session get asked again, and the second answer can contradict the first (O65's cause). Then you run /clear and /observe OP-01. Costs a few minutes and protects the reopen from hitting the same problem unnoticed.

options.label: Reopen now
options.description: You run /clear and /observe OP-01 right away. The split-dialog problem stays recorded only in O65 and the trace. Fastest path to the freeze.

options.label: PR first, then reopen
options.description: I open a PR with /pr for the branch as it stands (the reopens plus this review), so master holds the reviewed record before the next reopen. Adds a merge cycle before the freeze path continues.
